Granite.description: Granite, a rugged and unyielding stone imbued with ancient magic, grants its wearer unparalleled resilience, enhancing their natural defenses by a formidable margin. Its cold, stony essence whispers of enduring strength and time-tested protection.

Sandstone.description: The Sandstone, a rugged and ancient artifact etched with forgotten secrets, whispers of desert lore as it enhances your defenses by two points, grounding you in unyielding resilience.
